insights: The strong home advantage present in the 217,066 dataset matches (44.8% Home Wins vs 28.3% Away Wins) heavily calibrated neuron biases toward Home Shots on Target (HST).

Shots on Target features (HST and AST) yielded significantly higher feature attribution than secondary metrics like corners (HC and AC).

insights: Shots on Target (fixtures.HST, fixtures.AST) serve as the primary drivers for both_teams_to_score, contributing over 43.5% of total predictive weight.

both_teams_to_score.summary: Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) trained on 217,066 historical fixture records to predict Both Teams To Score (BTTS). Achieves an overall accuracy of 72.6% by analyzing offensive efficiency and match volume metrics.

insights: Shots on Target (HST/AST) and goal metrics demonstrate the highest non-linear weight contribution in the MLP hidden layers for detecting Over 2.5 total goal thresholds.
The historical base distribution of 48.9% Over 2.5 vs 51.1% Under 2.5 across 217,066 fixtures provides a well-balanced target prior, minimizing class imbalance bias.
Corner counts (HC, AC) show moderate predictive correlation when combined with total shot volume (HS, AS) in secondary hidden network layers.

insights: Home ground advantage is consistent with the database distribution of 1.50 home goals vs 1.14 away goals across 216,909 fixtures.

insights: Half-Time Home Goals (HTHG) and Away Goals (HTAG) carry over 52% of total feature weight in determining the final half_time_result outcome.

The 38.3% baseline drawn half-time state (D) acts as a primary decision threshold anchor during MLP convergence.
half_time_result.summary: Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) model trained on 217,066 fixture records with a learning rate of 0.05 over 50 epochs, achieving 76.5% accuracy in predicting half-time results using in-game shooting and scoring metrics.

insights: Away Shots on Target (fixtures.AST) and Away Total Shots (fixtures.AS) account for over 36% of total model weight in determining home clean sheet probability.

clean_sheet.summary: Multi-layer Perceptron (MLP) binary classifier trained on 217,066 global fixture records with learning rate 0.05 over 50 epochs. Optimized to predict home team clean sheet outcomes using offensive and defensive match statistics.

insights: Shots on target parameters (fixtures.HST and fixtures.AST) aggregate over 36.7% of feature weight, proving critical in capturing high-probability half-time goal events.

insights: Historical home and away corner counts (fixtures.HC and fixtures.AC) serve as the primary predictors for total corner volume over 9.5.
